top_signals.title: Ethlabs proposes advancing Ethereum’s post-quantum to 2027, citing AI acceleration
top_signals.summary: The group said it aims to make Ethereum post-AI by 2027 as well, resistant to cryptographic risks that AI development is bringing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Pakistan Militant Attack Kills 28 People in Restive Border Area
top_signals.summary: An attack on a police convoy in Pakistan’s restive northwest killed 28 policemen and militants on Wednesday, underscoring worsening violence in the region bordering Afghanistan.
